comparison.objective: Raise a hospital-bed half side rail until its latch catches.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasping and lifting an articulated rail through its guided path into a latch.
comparison.success_condition: Rail reaches the top position, is mechanically latched, released, and stable; false support or unsafe displacement does not qualify.
comparison.reason: Articulated lifting and latch engagement are meaningfully different from pouring and sifting mixed rigid bodies. No material rubric detail is missing.
